stages.prompt: We're recording customer events. Please create CustomerEvent with customer (text), occurred_at (timestamp), and message (text). Our main screen shows one customer's most recent events first; add a compound index ordered first by customer, then by occurred_at descending. Different events can share the same timestamp.

params.name: schema
params.sdl: type CustomerEvent @index(ordered:{includes:[{field:"customer"},{field:"occurred_at",direction:DESC}]}) { customer: String occurred_at: DateTime message: String }
